page.overview:
What is Lux Æterna?

Lux Æterna is the sixth track off of Metallica's eleventh studio album 72 Seasons.

It is also the lead single from the album. The song was written and composed by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich.

Anticipation In domination A sea of hearts beat as one, unified Magnification All Generations Approaching thunder, awaiting the light
